dmManager.name: DM Manager
dmManager.headline: 5 reply drafts ready to paste
dmManager.note: Instagram doesn't allow DM automation for personal profiles — these are copy-paste drafts and a triage system, not auto-replies.

triage.rule: Mentions symptoms + asks about working together → send 'discovery call' draft same day.
Asks a general Hashimoto's question → answer briefly, point to the Healing Hub.
RD/MD asking shop talk → warm short reply, no pitch.
Generic 'collab?' with no context → ignore or decline template.

drafts.text: Thank you for trusting me with this — what you're describing is so common with Hashimoto's, and it's not in your head. The best next step is a discovery call so I can hear the full picture: [link]. I'd love to help you get answers.
Great question — I can't interpret labs safely over DM, but this is exactly what I walk through inside the Healing Hub / on a call. What I *can* say: a 'normal' TSH alone doesn't rule anything out.
I made something for exactly this — the Hashimoto's Healing Hub. It's where I go deeper than I can on IG, and you can ask me questions directly: [link].
Careful with that one — it depends on your meds and labs. Quick rule I give everyone: keep magnesium, calcium and iron 4 hours away from thyroid medication.
Thank you for thinking of me! I keep partnerships limited to products I already use with clients, so I'll pass for now — wishing you the best with the launch.
